Four killed in Karnataka house fire after refrigerator explosion

Four members of a family died and two others were critically injured in a house fire in Belagavi, Karnataka. The fire reportedly started after a refrigerator exploded. The incident occurred in a residential area, and emergency services responded to the scene. The injured are receiving medical attention.
